solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Speed of a non-professional penning short review

indicators.note: penning means holding inside, like an animal in a pen, so one piece encloses the other

parts.note: lay means amateur, not of a profession
crit is a short form of critique, a review

explanation.surface: An amateur critic dashes off a brief review at speed.
explanation.definitionFit: Alacrity is brisk eagerness, so it is a synonym for speed or promptness.

clue.text: Unwisely raced round a shopping precinct

indicators.note: round means surrounding, so the scrambled letters go around the a
something done unwisely is done wildly, so the letters of raced are scrambled

explanation.surface: Someone drove recklessly around a shopping centre.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Unwisely' scrambles RACED into ARCDE, and 'round' puts it around A: ARC-A-DE.
explanation.definitionFit: An arcade is a covered row of shops, a kind of shopping precinct.

clue.text: Declare invalid must check blood group yearly

indicators.note: to check here is to hold back or contain, so the first piece holds the second inside it

parts.note: to annul is to declare a marriage or contract invalid
A is one of the blood groups

explanation.surface: An official voids a document unless a blood type is checked each year.
explanation.definitionFit: Annual means happening once every year, a synonym of yearly.

clue.text: Strengthen check on violence

indicators.note: in a down clue, on means placed above, so the first piece sits on top of the second

parts.note: a rein is a check or restraint
force means violence, as in by force

explanation.surface: Tougher controls are imposed to curb violence.
explanation.definitionFit: To reinforce is to make stronger, as with extra troops or supports.

clue.text: Article on mixed metaphors in a Molière play

indicators.note: in a down clue, on means placed above, so the article sits on top of the rest

parts.note: the is the definite article

indicators.note: mixed means jumbled, so the letters of metaphors in are rearranged

explanation.surface: A critic's essay on muddled metaphors in one of Molière's comedies.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mixed' rearranges METAPHORSIN into MISANTHROPE; the final 'a' belongs to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Le Misanthrope is a 1666 comedy by the French playwright Molière, known in English by this title.

clue.text: Beauty of a soft pedal little daughter ignored

parts.note: p is piano, the musical abbreviation for soft

indicators.note: ignored means left out, so a letter is dropped from the word pedal

parts.note: d is the short form of daughter

explanation.surface: A pianist plays a soft pedal while ignoring a small daughter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ignored' takes D out of PEDAL, leaving PEAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Appeal means attractiveness or charm, the sense in which beauty is a synonym.

clue.text: Simple map I found enclosed

indicators.note: found enclosed means discovered inside, so the letter sits within the other word

parts.note: a plan is a map or diagram

explanation.surface: A straightforward map with the letter I marked inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Plain means simple or unadorned, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Criminal drooled about a place of great riches

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the scrambled letters go around the a
criminal suggests something bent or corrupt, so the letters of drooled are twisted

explanation.surface: A crook salivated over the thought of a land of treasure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Criminal' scrambles DROOLED into ELDORDO, and 'about' puts it around A.
explanation.definitionFit: El Dorado was the legendary city of gold sought by explorers, hence any place of fabulous wealth.

clue.text: Publican left with master

parts.note: and means with, joining things together
a lord is a master or ruler

explanation.surface: A pub owner departed alongside the boss.
explanation.definitionFit: In Britain the keeper of a pub is commonly called its landlord, so publican is a synonym.

clue.text: A cig lame beggar lit in area within airport

indicators.note: lit is slang for drunk, so the letters of these words reel about

explanation.surface: A lame beggar lights a cigarette in part of the airport terminal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lit' looks like the cigarette being lit but is the anagram signal, meaning drunk.
explanation.definitionFit: Baggage reclaim is the hall in an airport where arriving passengers collect their luggage.

clue.text: Intern beginning to come on very well

indicators.note: beginning to means just the opening letter of the next word is used

parts.note: fine means very well, as in feeling fine

explanation.surface: A hospital trainee is told to start coming along nicely.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Intern' looks like the noun for a trainee, but here it is the verb, to imprison.
explanation.definitionFit: To intern is to imprison or detain, especially in wartime, so it is a synonym of confine.

clue.text: Give up completely on a group at the front

indicators.note: at the front says the a and group pieces come before the word on

parts.note: a band is a group, of musicians or people

explanation.surface: A frontman quits the band completely.
explanation.definitionFit: To abandon something is to give it up entirely, to desert or relinquish it.

clue.text: Happy, perhaps, participating in cold war film

indicators.note: participating in means taking part within, so the letters are found inside these words

explanation.surface: Someone is cheerful about acting in a Cold War movie.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Happy' looks like a mood, but it is one of the seven dwarfs in Snow White; 'perhaps' marks it as an example.
explanation.definitionFit: Happy is one of the seven dwarfs in the Snow White tale, so he is an example of one.

clue.text: Usually home ahead of army officer

indicators.note: ahead of means the first piece comes before the second

parts.note: to be in is to be at home
a general is a senior army officer

explanation.surface: The army officer usually comes home first.
explanation.definitionFit: In general is an idiom meaning as a rule, ordinarily.

clue.text: One producing notes by a crank?

definitions.text: One producing notes by a crank?

parts.words: One producing notes by a crank?
parts.note: a crank seems to be an eccentric person, but it is the handle turned on a barrel organ to make music

explanation.walkthrough: 'crank' suggests an oddball writing letters; it is the handle a street musician turns to play a barrel organ.
explanation.definitionFit: An organ-grinder is a street musician who plays a barrel organ by turning its handle.

clue.text: Ones imprisoned by country, Asian republic

indicators.note: imprisoned by means held inside, so the word ones sits within the country name

parts.note: India is a country

explanation.surface: People are jailed by a nation, an Asian republic.
explanation.definitionFit: Indonesia is a republic in Southeast Asia made up of thousands of islands.

clue.text: One running out of gear?

parts.note: out of gear seems to be about a car or engine, but here means without clothes, as a naked runner

explanation.walkthrough: 'out of gear' suggests a vehicle; gear here is clothing, so the runner is naked.
explanation.definitionFit: A streaker is someone who runs naked through a public place, such as a sports ground.

clue.text: Best supplied after diner finally leaves rice dish served cold

indicators.note: supplied after means the second piece is put after the first
leaves means goes away from, so a letter is removed from the word rice
finally means the last letter of diner is the one taken

parts.note: the cream is the best part, as in the cream of the crop

explanation.surface: A diner leaves the best rice dish served cold.
explanation.walkthrough: The diner seems to be walking out, but 'leaves' just drops their last letter from the grain word, giving ICE, with 'supplied after' adding the best part.
explanation.definitionFit: Ice cream is a frozen dessert, a dish eaten cold.

clue.text: Record label editor misspelled

parts.note: a ticket is a label or tag attached to goods

indicators.note: misspelled means written with letters in the wrong order, so editor is rearranged

explanation.surface: A record company's editor got the label spelt wrong.
explanation.definitionFit: Ticket to Ride is a 1965 single by the Beatles, so it is an example of a record.

clue.text: First of series of games is key

definitions.meaning: the first match in a sporting series, such as a season opening fixture
a tool that opens things; a key opens a lock

explanation.definitionFit: An opener is both the first game in a series and a device for opening, as a key unlocks a door.

clue.text: Still cold wearing tartan cloth

indicators.note: wearing means having something on, so the cloth goes around the letter

parts.note: plaid is tartan woollen cloth
C is the abbreviation for cold, as on a tap

explanation.surface: Someone is still cold despite wearing a tartan wrap.
explanation.definitionFit: Placid means calm and undisturbed, the sense of still as in still water.

clue.text: Unconventional English Cricket Club certain to change after losing away

indicators.note: to change means the remaining letters are rearranged
after losing means once a letter has been dropped from the word certain

parts.note: A stands for away, as in football fixture lists

explanation.surface: An English cricket club is sure to change its ways after an away defeat.
explanation.walkthrough: A for away is the football-results abbreviation; 'after losing' drops it, and 'to change' turns the leftover CERTIN into ENTRIC.
explanation.definitionFit: Eccentric means odd or departing from the norm, a synonym of unconventional.

clue.text: Hot during pleasant recess

indicators.note: during means within a span, so the letter goes inside the word

parts.note: nice means pleasant
H is the abbreviation for hot, as on a tap

explanation.surface: It's hot during a pleasant break.
explanation.walkthrough: 'recess' looks like a holiday break but means an alcove in a wall.
explanation.definitionFit: A niche is a shallow recess in a wall, often for a statue or ornament.

clue.text: The French female writer retired here, high in the Himalayas

indicators.note: retired means drawn back, so the letters are read in reverse

parts.note: la is the French feminine form of the
a pen is a writing implement

explanation.surface: A French woman writer went to live out her retirement in the high Himalayas.
explanation.definitionFit: Nepal is the country containing much of the Himalaya range, including Everest.

clue.text: Bone in neck ape fractured

indicators.note: fractured means broken, so the letters of neck ape are broken up and rearranged

explanation.surface: An ape has broken a bone in its neck.
explanation.definitionFit: The kneecap, or patella, is the small bone at the front of the knee.

clue.text: As found in medicines raved about

indicators.note: about means turned around, so the letters are read backwards
found in means contained within, so the letters are inside these words

explanation.surface: As found in medicines, someone raved about it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'As' looks like a conjunction but is the chemical symbol for the element.
explanation.definitionFit: As is the chemical symbol for the poisonous element number 33.

clue.text: Lewis certainly hurt back?

indicators.note: back means reversed, so the letters are read in reverse order

parts.note: yes means certainly, as an affirmative reply
to mar is to hurt or spoil

explanation.surface: Lewis certainly suffered an injury to his back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lewis' looks like a surname; it is a surname whose owner's first name is wanted.
explanation.definitionFit: Ramsey Lewis was an American jazz pianist, so the first name pairs with this surname.

clue.text: I'm married, and spoiled

parts.note: paired means joined together as a couple, like a married pair

explanation.surface: A newlywed declares the wedding ruined things.
explanation.definitionFit: Impaired means damaged or weakened, a synonym for spoiled.
